content:
I've just opened emilyriehl/infinity-cosmos#176 to move this project onto leanprover-community/intentions, the GitHub Actions version of the claim/dashboard bot (announcement).

It's a drop-in: the same claim / disclaim / propose PR / withdraw PR commands and the same board, reusing your existing PAT_TOKEN. I've set default-ttl: none, so claims still never expire, but you can configure this to give a default duration. Happy to adjust anything.
